description: This file defines the PlacementFilterDirectorResolver class, which is responsible for resolving an IPlacementFilterDirector instance based on a given PlacementFilterStrategy. It uses dependency injection to retrieve the appropriate service.

classes.name: PlacementFilterDirectorResolver
classes.description: A resolver class that provides an IPlacementFilterDirector based on the specified PlacementFilterStrategy.

methods.name: GetFilterDirector
methods.description: Returns an IPlacementFilterDirector for the specified PlacementFilterStrategy using dependency injection.

parameters.name: placementFilterStrategy
parameters.description: The strategy based on which the filter director is resolved.
